ida: Quick pitch: 30m 'Launchpad' webinar — 3 micro-demos (7min each) + 10min Q&A. Goal: tactical takeaways for product teams. Need speakers + 1-sentence abstracts by EOD Fri.
sam: Title idea: 'Launchpad: Practical Inference Playbooks'. Reg form should capture interest (benchmarks/embeddings/private) and team size.
marco: I'll bring a customer FinTech demo; will get Maya for a short recorded clip if needed. Wed rehearsal 9am PT works.
ava: Ops: prepare fallback clips + cached responses. Test streaming vs full-response for Demo 1. I'll upload test vectors and fallback clips by Thu EOD.
ida: Seed abstracts:
- Benchmarks: "3x token cost reduction via adaptive batching + prefix cache while keeping p99 stable."
- Quant: "Quantization tradeoffs: when it helps and how to detect regressions."
- Customer: "Embedding-first search: 50ms first-answer with routing fallbacks."
Please expand to 1-2 sentences.
sam: Lead routing: tag registrants interest=benchmarks|embeddings|private. Route benchmarks -> SDR A, others -> SDR B. Add utm=launchpad_playbook.
ops-bot: calendar: 'Launchpad rehearsal 12024-05-15 09:00 PT' created https://calendar.internal/evt/4721
maya: Happy to join; I'll supply a 30s clip + 1-paragraph blurb by Thu and confirm rehearsal.
ida: Also need 3-line live pivot script for each demo and 5 edge-case prompts per demo for rehearsal. Marketing ops: export segmented reg list daily to SDRs.
sam: I'll draft reg page copy + two subject lines to A/B test.
ida: Thanks team :thumbsup:
